The ruins of the old kingdom of men (D-089): the Kings' Gate of two colossi, the crowned king at a crossroads, fallen cities, old beacons and the tombs of forgotten kings across the gentle lands, the steppe and the moors, each with a chest of the old kings

Building the realms of men (D-060): each site's layout of parts (walls, towers, houses, halls, the square, gardens, fields), their column builders, the roads and bridges, per chunk

Building the wood elves of the forest kingdoms (D-065): cities in the goldboughs (platforms, winding stairs, houses round the trunks, bridges, golden crowns), the king's halls under a hill, tree-villages round feasting glades, watch-trees, glades; the hedge and gate, paths and lamps, the woodland roads

Building the mountain dwarves (D-066): terraces, granite houses, smithies, furnaces, headframes, cranes, engines of war, the hold's massif and great gate, and the sealed workings below (halls, forges, cistern, shafts, mines)

Into the basin and beneath it (W5, D-072): the front beyond a fallen gate, the forward camps and their garrisons, the wastes' places stormed (w.cl) and held by the hosts, the company that goes down with the player, the deep's warbands, the armies' ways to the front

The Emberlords remade (W7a, D-074): each lord's identity, temper and story (emberLord, ek), its powers (cleaving blade, dragging whip, leaps, breath, fissures, walls of fire, eruptions, summons) in three phases, its hall flooding with lava and cooling when it falls

The Emberlords in the war and their fates (W7b, D-075): each war's lord (warLord, w.el), showing itself at the height of assaults, driving the warhosts, its mountain's rumbles, eruptions and ash, the darker sky, its taunts; the last battles (the vents, its sally, the loremasters' rite) and the five fates
